latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Maker for Marketing — fast, easy AI-powered marketing video creation.

- Upload raw video footage (up to 500MB), describe your desired edit, and quickly export a polished 1080p MP4.
- Automatic session setup, with 100 free credits via anonymous authentication.
- Supports export, credit checking, file uploads, timeline preview, and common edit actions by prompt.
- Clear error handling for authentication, file size/type, credits, and export eligibility.
- Session-based editing allows iterative, fast-turnaround marketing video production without manual editing tools.
